why: Both files import the same lib/features/account/domain/services/pending_local_signup.dart and independently re-derive the same test matrix — tryParse null/missing-field/malformed-JSON handling, toJson round-trip, and every tryReserveEmail/releaseEmail case-insensitivity/multi-email scenario — 219 + 317 = 536 lines maintaining one behavior twice, with neither file referencing the other. recommendation: Keep pending_local_signup_test.dart (correctly named after its subject file) and delete pending_local_registration_test.dart; a line-by-line comparison shows no assertion in the latter that the former lacks.
